name: America PAC
summary: Elon Musk's super PAC, created in 2024 with tech backers to run canvassing for Trump's campaign; Musk supplied 91% of its money by December 2024, and the campaign outsourced much of its swing-state door-knocking to it. It spent heavily on Wisconsin's state Supreme Court race in 2025, and in the 2026 cycle raised $216 million and spent $172 million by mid-October, its biggest bet being Ken Paxton's Texas Senate run, which Paxton lost.

connections.name: Elon Musk
connections.description: More than $118 million by October 2024 (91% of its money), then $216 million in the 2026 cycle. In all he spent at least $250 million backing Trump in 2024, mostly through America PAC (other counts run higher). FEC filings show $377,699,130 from Elon Musk to America PAC in 2 cycles (2024–2026).
